title: Yale Real Living Push Button Deadbolt (YRD210): Installation and Programming Instructions
publisher: Yale Locks & Hardware / Yale Security Inc.
document_version: P/N AYRD-210-INST-FUL Rev G; 24-page PDF including Z-Wave and Zigbee module supplements

notes: Yale's official support directory links this PDF as the YRD210 keypad deadbolt manual: https://support.shopyalehome.com/where-do-i-find-installation-manuals-for-yrl-previous-generation--SJKr09bBH . The directory and linked PDF were inspected on the access date.
The main manual names YRD210, and the PDF includes separate Z-Wave and Zigbee module sheets. This does not identify the exact YRD210 PB DB firmware or full ZHA endpoint/cluster signature.
Use the manual for family-level battery and local indicator context, not as proof of a Zigbee raw-value scale or a correspondence between platform outputs.
